entities.name: Eckhart Von Falkenrath
entities.description: Baron of the Falkenrath vampire bloodline on Innistrad, long in league with Sifa Grent.

entities.name: Sifa Grent
entities.description: Planeswalker in league with the Baron who controls him with the Fang.

entities.name: Dack Fayden
entities.description: Planeswalker who saved Ingrid and fought the Baron.

entities.name: Ingrid Reichert
entities.description: Cathar saved by Dack, who later was left with the Baron's fate.

entities.name: Ancient Fang
entities.description: Weapon of great power that made Eckhart flee and let Dack control vampires.

events.summary: On arriving, Dack saves Ingrid and peasants from the Baron's vampires and fights him; Eckhart flees when Dack draws the Ancient Fang.
events.quote: Eckhart flew away, knowing the weapon's true power

events.summary: Sifa beats Eckhart before his vampires, then reveals it was a ruse as she is powerless without the Fang.
events.quote: Sifa revealed that it was a ruse and that she was powerless without the Fang

events.summary: Dack uses a spell and the Fang to control the Baron's vampires, foiling an ambush; he leaves the Baron's fate to Ingrid.
events.quote: leaving the Baron's fate in Ingrid's hands

relations.quote: he was in league with the planeswalker Sifa Grent
